recipe.name: Goat's Milk Yoghurt Bowl with Peach, Walnuts and Seeds
instructions: Spoon goat's milk yoghurt into a bowl.
Whisk whey protein powder with a splash of water into a thick paste and fold into the yoghurt.
Top with chopped peach and blueberries.
Sprinkle over walnuts and chia seeds.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Chicken and White Bean Salad with Fennel, Peas and Lemon

ingredients.name: Chicken breast, skinless, cooked and sliced

instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Blanch green peas in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain and cool.
In a large bowl, combine salad greens, fennel, cherry tomatoes, red onion, white beans and peas.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, dill, salt and pepper for the dressing.
Toss the salad with dressing and divide onto a plate.
Top with sliced chicken breast and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Mexican Grilled Beef with Charred Fennel, Mushrooms and Brown Rice
instructions: Rub beef sirloin with cumin, ancho chile powder, garlic and salt; let sit 10 minutes.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over high heat, sear beef 3-4 minutes per side to medium-rare, rest and slice against the grain.
Toss fennel slices and mushrooms with olive oil, grill/char 5-6 minutes until softened and lightly blackened at edges.
Warm brown rice and squeeze lime juice over rice and vegetables.
Plate rice, top with charred fennel and mushrooms, fan sliced beef over the top, scatter cilantro.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Fennel-Dill Boiled Eggs with Green Peas
instructions: Boil eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Steam green peas for 3 minutes until tender.
Toss sliced fennel with a drizzle of maple syrup.
Arrange eggs with peas and fennel, season with salt and pepper.

recipe.name: Sardine and Leek Pâté on Whole-Grain Toast

ingredients.name: Tinned sardines in olive oil, drained

instructions: Sauté sliced leek in a dry non-stick pan until soft, about 5 minutes.
Mash sardines with yoghurt, lemon juice and cooked leek until a chunky pâté forms.
Season with black pepper and stir through fresh dill.
Toast the whole-grain bread slices.
Spread the sardine pâté generously over the toast and serve.

recipe.name: Indian Roast Salmon with Brussels Sprouts and Leeks
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Mix yoghurt, garam masala, turmeric, ginger and garlic into a marinade; coat salmon and let sit 10 minutes.
Toss Brussels sprouts and leeks with olive oil and a pinch of salt on a roasting tray.
Roast vegetables for 10 minutes, then add marinated salmon to the tray and roast a further 10-12 minutes until salmon is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Toasted Pumpkin Seed Portion
instructions: Dry toast pumpkin seeds in a small pan over low heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Cool slightly and serve in a small bowl.

recipe.name: Beef and Green Pea Baked Beans on Toast

ingredients.name: Haricot beans in tomato sauce (no added sugar)

instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté crimini mushrooms until golden.
Add cooked beef mince and green peas, warming through for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the beans in tomato sauce and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Toast the whole-grain bread.
Spoon the bean and beef mixture over toast, garnish with parsley and serve.

recipe.name: Thai Braised Beef and Mushroom in Fennel Broth
instructions: Sear beef cubes in a hot pot until browned on all sides.
Add lemongrass, galangal, chile and kaffir lime leaves, stir for 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and fish sauce, bring to a simmer, cover and braise 15 minutes.
Add mushrooms and fennel, continue braising 8-10 minutes until beef is tender and vegetables soft.
Rest 5 minutes off heat, stir through basil leaves before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Goat's Milk Yoghurt with Maple Drizzle
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a small bowl.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Scrambled Eggs and Smoked Salmon with Fennel on Toast
instructions: Sauté sliced fennel in butter over medium heat until softened, about 6 minutes.
Whisk eggs with goat's milk and pour into the pan with fennel.
Scramble gently until just set.
Toast the whole-grain bread and top with the fennel scramble.
Lay smoked salmon over the top, sprinkle with dill and serve.

recipe.name: Japanese Calf's Liver and Mushroom Curry with Green Peas
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan, sauté leeks and garlic until fragrant.
Add mushrooms and cook 3 minutes until softened.
Push vegetables aside, quickly sear liver slices 1 minute per side (do not overcook).
Stir in curry powder, stock and soy sauce, simmer 5 minutes.
Add green peas, cook 2 more minutes until liver is just cooked through and sauce slightly thickened.
Rest 2 minutes before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Stone Fruit and Salmon Protein Bites
instructions: Flake cooked salmon into small pieces.
Arrange sliced fresh peach alongside salmon on a plate.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipe.name: Cocoa Cherry Protein Shake with Oats and Flax
instructions: Add water, whey protein powder and creatine to a blender.
Add frozen cherries, oats, cocoa powder and ground flaxseeds.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Greek One-Pan Salmon with Fennel, Leeks and Brown Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°C.
Arrange fennel, leeks and cherry tomatoes on a baking tray, drizzle with half the olive oil, roast 10 minutes.
Push vegetables aside, place salmon on the tray, drizzle remaining oil, sprinkle oregano.
Return to oven and roast 10-12 minutes until salmon is cooked through.
Scatter olives and feta over the tray, squeeze lemon juice, serve directly from the pan.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Leek and Herb Boiled Egg
instructions: Boil egg for 9 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Sauté finely sliced leeks in a dry non-stick pan until soft, about 5 minutes.
Top egg halves with sautéed leeks, flaked salmon and chopped chives.
Season with sea salt and serve warm.

recipe.name: Slow-Poached Peach and Brown Rice Yoghurt Bowl
instructions: Gently poach halved peach in a small pan with a splash of water and cinnamon for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Cool poached peach slightly, then set aside.
Spoon Greek yoghurt into a bowl and layer with cooked brown rice.
Top with poached peach and fresh strawberries.
Sprinkle over chopped almonds and hemp seeds, then drizzle with maple syrup.

recipe.name: Korean Beef and Mushroom Stir Fry with Green Peas and Brown Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat, stir fry beef slices 2 minutes until browned, remove and set aside.
Add garlic, ginger and mushrooms to the wok, stir fry 2-3 minutes.
Return beef to the wok, add green peas, soy sauce and maple syrup, toss 2 minutes until glossy and heated through.
Serve over warm brown rice, garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Beef and Pumpkin Seed Snack Plate

ingredients.name: Lean organic beef, thinly sliced and pan-seared

instructions: Season and pan-sear thin beef slices for 1-2 minutes per side until just cooked, let rest.
Toast pumpkin seeds in a dry skillet for 2-3 minutes.
Shave fennel thinly and arrange with beef and pumpkin seeds on a plate.
Sprinkle with sea salt and serve.

recipe.name: Mackerel and Brussels Sprout Pâté on Whole-Grain Toast

ingredients.name: Tinned mackerel in olive oil, drained

instructions: Finely shred Brussels sprouts and sauté in a dry pan for 5-6 minutes until tender and lightly caramelized.
Mash mackerel with yoghurt and lemon juice until a chunky pâté forms.
Fold in the sautéed Brussels sprouts and season with black pepper.
Toast the whole-grain bread slices.
Spread the mackerel pâté over toast, garnish with chives and serve.

recipe.name: Middle Eastern Grilled Beef Skewers with Charred Fennel, Brussels Sprouts and Date-Maple Glaze
instructions: Marinate beef cubes with garlic, sumac, cumin and half the olive oil for 10 minutes; thread onto skewers.
Simmer chopped dates with maple syrup and a splash of water 5 minutes to make a glaze.
Toss Brussels sprouts and fennel wedges with remaining olive oil, grill or roast 12-15 minutes until charred and tender.
Grill beef skewers 6-8 minutes, turning, basting with date-maple glaze in the final 2 minutes.
Serve skewers over warm brown rice with charred vegetables, scatter parsley on top.

recipe.name: Goat's Milk Yoghurt Bowl with Brown Rice and Maple Peach
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with cooked brown rice and diced fresh peach.
Sprinkle with chopped walnuts and drizzle with maple syrup.
Serve immediately.

aggregated_ingredients.crimini mushrooms, sliced/halved: 300g + 250g + 250g + 200g sliced/halved (for Mexican beef, Thai braised beef, Japanese liver curry, Korean stir fry)
aggregated_ingredients.fennel bulb, sliced: 400g + 200g + 200g sliced (for Mexican beef, Thai braised beef, Greek salmon)
aggregated_ingredients.leeks, sliced: 150g + 150g + 100g sliced (for Indian salmon, Japanese liver curry, Greek salmon)
aggregated_ingredients.garlic, minced: 20g x5 minced (for Mexican beef, Indian salmon, Japanese liver curry, Korean stir fry, and Thai braised beef aromatics prep)
aggregated_ingredients.ginger, grated: 20g + 20g grated (for Indian salmon, Korean stir fry)
aggregated_ingredients.brown rice, cooked: 1000g + 250g portioned (for Mexican beef, Korean stir fry)
aggregated_ingredients.green peas: 200g + 100g (for Japanese liver curry, Korean stir fry)
aggregated_ingredients.beef, cubed/sliced: 600g + 400g + 400g trimmed and cut (for Mexican grilled beef, Thai braised beef, Korean stir fry)
aggregated_ingredients.lemon/lime juice: 60g lime + 20g lemon + 20g lemon squeezed (for Mexican beef, Indian salmon, Greek salmon)

timeline.name: Phase 1: Start Thai Braised Beef (slow braise)
timeline.description: Sear cubed chuck beef, add lemongrass, galangal, chile, kaffir lime leaves, then coconut milk and fish sauce; bring to simmer and cover to braise unattended while other prep continues. Add mushrooms and fennel partway through per method timing.

timeline.name: Phase 2: Preheat ovens and start Indian Roast Salmon vegetables
timeline.description: Preheat oven to 220°C. Toss Brussels sprouts and sliced leeks with olive oil and salt on a roasting tray, place in oven to roast unattended while marinade and other proteins are prepped.

timeline.name: Phase 3: Aggregated chopping and slicing
timeline.description: Chop/slice all shared vegetables in one pass: fennel bulb (for Mexican beef, Thai braised beef, Greek salmon), leeks (Indian salmon, Japanese liver curry, Greek salmon), crimini mushrooms (all four beef/liver dishes), scallions, and mince all garlic and grate ginger needed across recipes.

timeline.name: Phase 4: Marinate and rub proteins
timeline.description: Rub sirloin steak with cumin, ancho chile powder, garlic and salt for Mexican beef; mix yoghurt, garam masala, turmeric, ginger and garlic marinade and coat salmon for Indian dish; let both sit while other tasks proceed.

timeline.name: Phase 5: Sear and grill Mexican beef, char vegetables
timeline.description: Sear seasoned sirloin steak 3-4 minutes per side, rest and slice against grain. Toss fennel and mushroom slices with olive oil and char on grill pan. Portion with warmed brown rice, lime juice and cilantro into containers.

timeline.name: Phase 6: Finish Indian Roast Salmon
timeline.description: Add marinated salmon to roasting tray with vegetables, return to oven to roast unattended 10-12 minutes. Finish with lemon juice, portion into containers.

timeline.name: Phase 7: Finish Thai Braised Beef and portion
timeline.description: Once braise is tender, rest off heat 5 minutes, stir through basil leaves, portion into airtight containers.

timeline.name: Phase 8: Japanese Calf's Liver and Mushroom Curry
timeline.description: Sauté prepped leeks and garlic in sesame oil, add mushrooms, sear liver slices briefly, stir in curry powder, stock and soy sauce, simmer, add green peas. Rest briefly and portion into containers.

timeline.name: Phase 9: Greek One-Pan Salmon with Fennel, Leeks and Brown Rice
timeline.description: Preheat second oven zone or reuse oven at 210°C. Arrange prepped fennel, leeks and cherry tomatoes on tray, roast, then add salmon and roast further. Scatter olives and feta, finish with lemon juice, portion into containers.

timeline.name: Phase 10: Korean Beef and Mushroom Stir Fry
timeline.description: Stir fry sliced sirloin beef in sesame oil, remove, stir fry garlic, ginger and mushrooms, return beef, add green peas, soy sauce and maple syrup, toss until glossy. Serve over portioned brown rice, garnish with scallions and sesame seeds, pack into containers.

timeline.name: Phase 11: Final portioning, labeling and fridge storage
timeline.description: Portion all six finished dishes into airtight containers, label with dish name and eat-by date, refrigerate immediately. No freezer items required this week as all dishes are consumed within the 4-day fridge-safe window.
